summary: Added the itemized-output and progress-acknowledgment protocol to xs-rs and xs-wire. C++ clients now get itemized events from xs-rs receivers, xs-rs clients render C++ receiver events, DIR frames carry the negotiated output metadata, and progress acknowledgments are bounded and feature-gated. All three gate commands pass with XS_BIN set to the parent C++ xs.
diagnosis: The work was protocol and interop work rather than benchmarking: the C++ reference puts per-entry size/source fields in DIR whenever PF_OUTPUT is negotiated, directory size/attr_source in the DIR header only with PF_DIR_OUTPUT, output events on F_OUTPUT, and completion snapshots on F_PROGRESS. The time went into matching those layouts and validating them against the parent binary; the new integration suite runs each direction across both implementations plus hostile-peer cases.
change: Added xs-wire::output with byte-pinned OutputEvent, OutputConfig handling and ProgressAck codecs plus strict C++-style validation. Advertise PF_OUTPUT, PF_DIR_OUTPUT and PF_PROGRESS_ACK conditionally; send and parse OUTPUT_CONFIG in feature order; add the PF_OUTPUT per-entry fields and PF_DIR_OUTPUT directory header fields. xs-rs now renders %i/%n/%f/%L/%l/%b/%o/%t/%% with C++ escaping and sorted output, generates itemized events for local and remote receivers, sends throttled progress snapshots before DONE, and refuses malformed, unnegotiated or oversized output/progress frames.
expected_effect: C++ clients can use -v, -i, -ii and --out-format against xs-rs, and --progress pushes receive receiver completion snapshots; xs-rs clients interoperate with C++ servers for the same flags. Transfer data paths and speed are otherwise unchanged.
risks: Itemization of unusual metadata-only changes (replaced non-regular types, hard-link and extended-attribute columns) is approximated; deletion output, --log-file, --stats and dry-run summaries are outside this step. The C++ client's own output_event fills zero timestamps, so xs-rs also stamps zero-time events locally.
tests: Added 4 xs-wire unit tests pinning F_OUTPUT/F_PROGRESS bytes and refusals, and 12 rs/xs-rs/tests/output.rs integration tests covering C++ push/pull itemization, xs-rs push/pull rendering, format fields, local copies, progress ACK ordering, malformed output configuration, unnegotiated configuration and a hostile control-byte output event. Ran: XS_BIN=~/benchmarks/lab/engineer/XR10201658-output/parent/build/xs cargo test --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml (all 84 tests passed); cargo clippy --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml --check (both clean).
commit_title: Port itemized output and progress acknowledgments to xs-rs
commit_body: Match the C++ PF_OUTPUT, PF_DIR_OUTPUT and PF_PROGRESS_ACK step. Add F_OUTPUT and F_PROGRESS codecs with the C++ field order and validation, negotiate output only when asked, send and read OUTPUT_CONFIG in feature order, carry per-entry source/size and directory source/size fields, render itemized lines and formats client-side, and acknowledge receiver completion with bounded progress snapshots. Add byte-pinned unit tests and C++/Rust interop tests for both directions, local copies and hostile peers.
